finger.rationale: Balances immediate tactile responsiveness against unintended jitter caused by physiological finger tremors and contact area expansion during initial press.

apple_pencil.rationale: High precision tip geometry and sub-millimeter tracking accuracy permit a 60% lower threshold, allowing precise drawing/scrolling handoff.

trackpad_mouse.input_device: Indirect Pointer / Magic Trackpad / Mouse Scroll
trackpad_mouse.rationale: Hardware filter removes noise at the controller level; indirect trackpad gestures require near-instantaneous scroll activation to eliminate perceived latency.

delaysContentTouches_delay.description: Duration that initial touchesBegan event is withheld from subviews in content hierarchy to determine whether gesture represents a scroll initiation or content interaction.

scroll_detection_timeout.description: Maximum allowable interval for touch movement accumulation prior to resetting stationary tracking markers.

velocity_lookback_window.description: Rolling temporal window within which historical touch coordinates are sampled to compute release velocity vector upon touchesEnded:.

vertical_lock_min_angle_deg.description: If initial drag angle theta >= 60 degrees from horizontal, gesture locks exclusively to vertical axis. Horizontal movement is clamped to 0.0.

horizontal_lock_max_angle_deg.description: If initial drag angle theta <= 30 degrees from horizontal, gesture locks exclusively to horizontal axis. Vertical movement is clamped to 0.0.

diagonal_neutral_zone.description: When initial trajectory falls within the 30-60 degree neutral band, both axes remain unlocked for free 2D bidirectional scrolling.

lock_break_displacement_multiplier.description: To break an active directional lock, user must exert perpendicular displacement exceeding 4x the touch slop (40.0 pt) sustained over at least 3 display cycles.

min_fling_velocity.description: Minimum release speed required to trigger ballistic deceleration animation. Releases below 10 pt/s rest immediately without momentum.

max_fling_velocity_cap.description: Clamping ceiling applied to computed release velocity vector to prevent numerical explosion and display instability.

terminal_stop_velocity.description: Deceleration termination threshold. When instantaneous velocity magnitude drops below 0.1 pt/s, CADisplayLink is invalidated and animation stops.

coordinate_ema_alpha.description: Exponential moving average filter coefficient smoothing digitizer quantization noise while maintaining 8.33ms responsiveness.

velocity_weight_time_constant_tau.description: Exponential decay factor weighting historical samples in least-squares velocity estimation. Recent touches receive exponentially higher weight.

interruption_slop_bypass_pt.description: When a new touch is detected while isDecelerating == 1, normal touch slop (10pt) is collapsed to 0pt for instantaneous drag re-acquisition.

presentation_offset_catch_tolerance_pt.description: Maximum allowable alignment discrepancy between CALayer presentationLayer origin and internal _contentOffset upon deceleration halt.
